format.description: A calc row's format: amount (the currency's decimals), percent (the quotient times 100, 1 decimal) or ratio (2 decimals), rounded once, half away from zero (RND-KPI).

formula.description: A calc row's formula: numbers, the IDs of rows above it, + - * / and brackets, such as (rev - cogs) / rev. A division by zero is not available, never zero.

group.description: A group row's report group, as the chart names it.

id.description: The row's ID: lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. A formula names a row by it.

kind.description: account: one account by its code; group: every account of a report group of the chart; calc: a formula over rows above it; heading: a label with no figures.
